description:
Describe your situation and receive a short recommended sequence of treatments, each with a reason, plus one quieter room that's also open. The welcome mat, and the fastest way to learn the whole menu.

Tell Ivy how you are, and she'll suggest a day. You're welcome to ignore it.

guest_pass.description: Your private pass from spa.checkin, so the spa knows it's you. Leave it out and you're a walk-in, welcome but not remembered.
